tasks.build: deno task build:clean && deno task build:bundle && deno task build:static
tasks.build:bundle: deno bundle --platform browser --outdir dist src/background.ts src/content.ts src/injected.ts src/popup.ts
tasks.build:static: cp src/manifest.json src/popup.html dist/ && cp src/icons/* dist/icons/ && curl -s https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.min.js -o dist/lib/qrcode.min.js
